title: Anthropic Messages API — parsing a text response
pins: The parsed result produced from a raw Anthropic Messages body, with the USAGE ARITHMETIC as the reason the suite exists: the reasoning count Anthropic reports at usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens, the difference between that count being absent and being zero, and the cache counts Anthropic reports beside the prompt rather than inside it.
findings: G-48 — Anthropic reasoning tokens were dropped in ALL THREE languages until 2026-09-05: omitted in PHP, a literal null in TypeScript, hardcoded None in Python. Because the three AGREED, no cross-language comparison could see it, and the corpus asserted thought_tokens sixteen times without one of them being Anthropic. Reported by a human measuring the live API (Moic Suite, prism#33). This suite is the mechanical check that was missing. Goldens are NOT yet generated: the released reference the runner installs is v0.116.0, which predates the fix, so generating now would enshrine the defect and fail the ports that are already correct. They land when a release carrying the fix does.
